```{python}
top5_tbl = (
    michels_2017
    .group_by("eventdate")
    .agg(n=pl.len())
    .sort("n", descending=True)
    .head(5)
)

top5 = int(top5_tbl.select(pl.col("n").sum()).item())
```

## Discussion questions

```{python}
#| echo: false
(
    michels_2017
    .with_columns(
        days_to_filing=(
            pl.col("date_filed") - pl.col("eventdate")
        ).dt.total_days()
    )
    .ggplot()
    .aes(x="days_to_filing", fill="recognize")
    .geom_histogram(binwidth=1)
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
(
    michels_2017
    .with_columns(
        days_to_period_end=(
            pl.col("next_period_end") - pl.col("eventdate")
        ).dt.total_days()
    )
    .ggplot()
    .aes(x="days_to_period_end", fill="recognize")
    .geom_histogram(binwidth=1)
)
```
